one_liner: Miho Dorm's big-sister dorm head who turns everything into a one-on-one 'taiman' showdown, then feeds everyone.
personality: Hishi Amazon is a loud, warm, hot-blooded 'ane-go' (big sister boss) who calls herself Hishiama-nee and frames training, races, even eating contests as a taiman (one-on-one duel). As Miho Dorm head she mothers everyone: cooking, sewing, patrolling curfew, fixing the trainer's collar, nagging about sleep and hydration. She is the youngest child in her family, cries easily when the dorm celebrates her, and gets flustered by anything frilly or romantic.

story_arc.summary: A hot-blooded dorm head who lives for taiman, Hishi Amazon runs the Triple Tiara route (Hanshin JF, Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho) per her race-goal titles while chasing her real target: a one-on-one with Narita Brian (秋華賞の後に・アイツのいる場所へ, ジャパンCの後に・そして、タイマンへ). Along the way she questions what being the strong, proud 'Hishi Amazon' means (強く気高い“ヒシアマゾン”に, アタシのタイマン、アンタのタイマン). Her later goals include the Arima Kinen, Osaka Hai, Yasuda Kinen and Japan Cup. In the game she can achieve the Triple Tiara (秋華賞の後に・トリプルティアラ達成); historically the real foreign-bred horse could not enter those Classic races (model knowledge, unverified).
story_arc.source: event titles; model knowledge (unverified) for the foreign-bred detail
